original_clock: Original R1 step s=t/tau evolves dz/ds=v, dv/ds=-3*hmid*v-r^2*(z-Xlin) with dx/ds=hmid on each interval, hmid=tau*sqrt(H_i*H_i+1). Physical background has dx/ds=tau*H_true(x).
original_x_embedded_state: At any original interval x sample, reconstruct original frozen step z_step(x),v_step(x) with delta_s=(x-x_i)/hmid. Physical derivative is dz_step/dt=gamma*v_step/tau with gamma=tau*H_true(x)/hmid, not the D13 internal-clock v_step/tau unless gamma=1.
exact_clock_consistent_GE05_Euler: R_GE05=d_t[a^3*dz_step/dt]+a^3*(r/tau)^2*(z_step-Xtrue)=a^3*(r/tau)^2*[(1-gamma^2)*(z_step-Xlin)+(Xlin-Xtrue)]+a^3*gamma*H_x*v_step/tau. This exact identity requires differentiable source H_true(x), source Xtrue(x) and original action normalization.
unknown_drive_component: R_drive=a^3*(r/tau)^2*(Xlin-Xtrue). If eps_X>=|Xlin-Xtrue| for all original six input modes, the absolute signed Fourier bath drive contribution is bounded by U_X*eps_X, where U_X is the original source-node/mode-pair absolute-sum coefficient at each collocation point.
action_background: Use original Repair13 H^2=(Q*KQ-K)/3+C/a^3+rho_lambda and H_x=(-Q*KQ-3C/a^3)/(2H), same original stable positive Exp branch and I0=a^3 KQ. Cross-check all original knots with frozen Repair13 H and constant rho_lambda; never silently replace original H with CLASS H or an arbitrary interpolant.
original_scope: Original C_min/C_star/C_max x Nt128/Nt64 x Nq2048/Nq1024; six positive and conjugate negative Fourier modes; full original six-mode signed m0..40 convolution; no original high-phase node discarded, no full m0..64 bath archive claimed.
archive_checks: Original SHA D13/D14 JSON/NPZ and R1 trace, source blob locks and certified H3F/H3G/Z11/Repair13 parents, D13 same physical sampled signed bath parent and phase arrays, exact original interval endpoint R1 step reproduction, original action H source knot reconstruction.
meaning_of_PASS: Conditional sampled x-embedded original-action bath clock and drive-coefficient diagnostic only. Finite collocation points do not establish a full-interval supremum or original first-order GE05 bath on-shell. The true continuous X10 parent and state-propagation/time/quadrature error budgets remain open.
